description: What the suite about the other settings and the other chats must notice: calls behind the proposal that run, the mode of a task after an approval, the mode changed under a running task, hooks and checks, a plan addressed by another spelling of its id or in another studio, two decisions that both win.

mutations.name: M1
mutations.what: the calls behind an approved proposal run

mutations.name: M2
mutations.what: the step of the approval is not noted

patches.old: context.planApprovedStep = task.steps; // the calls behind this one in the same model turn (#dispatch)

mutations.name: M3
mutations.what: every later call of the run is refused

mutations.name: M4
mutations.what: the mode can change while a task is active

mutations.name: M5
mutations.what: Full Access applies to a task whose owner chose a mode

mutations.name: M6
mutations.what: the mode the owner chose is not the mode of the task

mutations.name: M7
mutations.what: Read Only does not win over the choice

mutations.name: M8
mutations.what: a hook is asked about a call the gate refused

mutations.name: M9
mutations.what: a plan-mode run runs the trusted checks

patches.old: run: context.gate, task, planMode: planOnly(task), signal
patches.new: run: context.gate, task, planMode: false, signal

mutations.name: M10
mutations.what: a plan is found by its id in any case

mutations.name: M11
mutations.what: the plan decision takes an id in any case

mutations.name: M12
mutations.what: the plan of a chat beside another is looked for in the Hub's own studio

mutations.name: M13
mutations.what: a plan that waits on the gate of a chat beside another is not seen

mutations.name: M14
mutations.what: a request that was answered can be answered again

mutations.name: M15
mutations.what: an answer about a later revision is taken

patches.old: if ((approved || revision !== null) && current.revision !== base) throw planConflict(current);
patches.new: if ((approved || revision !== null) && current.revision < base) throw planConflict(current);
